name: local-llm
about: Run open-weight LLMs on this workspace's GPU (llama.cpp, ik_llama.cpp, Ollama, vLLM); weights download only on Run
description: Runs open-source LLMs on this machine's GPU with llama.cpp, ik_llama.cpp or Ollama, and with vLLM once an admin installs it. Admins pick a model and a runner in Settings; weights download only when Run is pressed. Its manifest declares GPU access (containerSecurity.gpu); on the host, ploinky gpu revoke --agent local-llms/local-llm takes it away and ploinky gpu grant --agent local-llms/local-llm restores it.

capabilities.summary: Serves the open-weight model an administrator runs on this workspace's GPU.
capabilities.whenToUse: Call soul_gateway/local-llms/local-llm/default for private, on-machine generation once a model is ready; it answers 503 not_ready otherwise.
